reason: I would take the free list of 15 companies, because it costs me nothing but a call, but I would not put EUR 1,500 down this month. The last agency also looked good on paper and gave me slides, so I want to see what they produce before I pay anyone.
objection: Their proof is a logistics company, not a wholesaler like me. My buyers know their suppliers personally, and I doubt an email from a new domain gets a real buyer to take a call. If the 15 companies are names I already know or could find myself, they do not understand my niche.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company sample has real buyers I have not already approached, with reasons that show they understand my product, and I can speak to a past client who is a wholesaler or distributor and got paying customers, not only meetings.
